notes.title: How to stream movies
notes.content:
1.Prepare a movie(mp4 format).
2.Upload it somewhere. *For DropBox, change the end of URL from "dl=0" to "dl=1"
3.Shorten the URL. *ex.http://bit.ly/2pRm8mb
4.Enter ">movie=ShortURL" in chat field.
*Required a screen in the room and permission from the host.
